description: This source file defines the TailscaleService class, which manages Tailscale integration, status checking, and interactions for a macOS application. It includes methods for checking installation, fetching status via API, and opening related URLs.

classes.name: TailscaleService
classes.description: A singleton class managing Tailscale's system integration, status checking, and user interface interactions.

methods.name: checkAppInstallation
methods.description: Checks if the Tailscale app is installed on the system.

methods.name: fetchTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Fetches the current Tailscale status via the local API.

methods.name: checkTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive check of Tailscale's installation and running status, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: openAppStore
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale app page on the Mac App Store.

methods.name: openSetupGuide
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale setup guide webpage.

methods.name: fallbackTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Provides a fallback method to detect the Tailnet IPv4 address.
